The frame shows covers including A Very Long Bull (September 17, 2018) and the February 2012 United-Continental Let's Get It On cover. The reel names no resources, so the archive expands it with verified places to browse the covers (official issue archive, CoverJunkie, Jordi Ng's portfolio, Internet Archive scans, EBSCO backfile), design coverage of the Turley era, and the two covers visible in the frame. Links checked 2026-10-11.
